work_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/tmu-data.XXXXXX")
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$work_tmp"
for endpoint in programme-categories-new programme-by-college/1 programme-by-college/2; do

  printf '"'%s ' \""'$endpoint"; wc -c < "$work_tmp/$name.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  head -c 180 "$work_tmp/$name.json" 2>/dev/null; printf '"'\\n'
done
printf '%s\\n' '--- top-level JSON summary ---'
jq -r 'type, (if type==\"array\" then (\"categories=\" + (length|tostring)) else keys[] end)' \""'$work_tmp/programme-categories-new.json" 2>&1 | sed -n '"'1,80p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- category and programme names ---'
jq -r '.[] | [.id,.name,(.programs|length)] | @tsv' \""'$work_tmp/programme-categories-new.json" | sed -n '"'1,120p'"

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'db="$PWD/assets/data/career_path.db"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- relevant paths ---'
sqlite3 -header -separator "'$'"'\\t' \"file:"'$db?mode=ro" "with recursive path(id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id,breadcrumb) as (select n.id,n.slug,n.name,n.parent_id,n.stream_id,s.name||'"' > '||n.name from career_nodes n join streams s on s.id=n.stream_id where n.parent_id is null union all select n.id,n.slug,n.name,n.parent_id,n.stream_id,path.breadcrumb||' > '||n.name from career_nodes n join path on n.parent_id=path.id) select id,slug,breadcrumb from path where lower(breadcrumb) like '%medical%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%dental%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%pharmacy%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%nurs%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%engineering%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%computer%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%business%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%management%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%law%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%agric%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%education%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%physio%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%fine art%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%physical education%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%forensic%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%optometry%' or lower(breadcrumb) like '%animation%' order by id;\" | sed -n '1,300p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- science roots and descendants depth <=2 ---'
sqlite3 -header -separator "'$'"'\\t' \"file:"'$db?mode=ro" "with recursive path(id,slug,name,parent_id,stream_id,depth,breadcrumb) as (select n.id,n.slug,n.name,n.parent_id,n.stream_id,0,s.name||'"' > '||n.name from career_nodes n join streams s on s.id=n.stream_id where n.parent_id is null union all select n.id,n.slug,n.name,n.parent_id,n.stream_id,path.depth+1,path.breadcrumb||' > '||n.name from career_nodes n join path on n.parent_id=path.id) select id,slug,depth,breadcrumb from path where stream_id=1 and depth<=2 order by id;\" | sed -n '1,280p'"
